title: BNPL Diamond: APR, Introductory Interest-Free Period, and Late Payment Fees
summary: BNPL Diamond: standard APR is 12.49% on outstanding balances (interest accrues after any introductory period ends). Purchases are interest-free for 3 months from plan start (if 3=0, interest accrues from start). Late payments incur a fee of 2.5% of the overdue installment amount, potentially per missed due date until the overdue amount is cured.
